services.desc: The McHenry Museum is a City of Modesto landmark, and is operated by the City’s Parks, Recreation & Neighborhoods Department. The McHenry Museum, with its Main Exhibit room, Temporary Exhibition room, and lower-level Auditorium provides one of the most flexible small venues in the city of Modesto. The main floor of the Museum can accommodate 200 guests while the auditorium will accommodate 64 to 90 guests depending upon the chair/table configuration. The rental fee for the Main Floor is $800 for a minimum of four (4) hours and each additional hour is $131. A refundable cleaning and damage deposit is required and is equal to half the rent total. blurb: Located in Downtown Modesto at 1402 I Street, the McHenry Museum invites you to join the thousands of annual visitors who come to engage with the rich and diverse history of Modesto and Stanislaus County. Open three days a week, guests enjoy immersive exhibits in an upbeat and friendly setting, showcasing two-hundred (200!) years of unique and storied local history.
